description:
Sanjeevani Ke Liye Pura Pahad Utha Laaye! 🌿

🔱 Hanuman carried Dronagiri mountain Sanjeevani Laxman life

When Lakshmana was gravely injured in battle, Hanuman was sent to bring Sanjeevani herb from the Himalayan Dronagiri mountain. Unable to identify the exact herb, Hanuman lifted the entire mountain and brought it to Lanka. After Lakshmana was healed, Hanuman returned the mountain.

👉 Hanuman ki jagah aap kya karte — poori pahad ya ek booti?
